notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP: curl and WebFetch on /cp/, /search, and /sitemap_category.xml URLs, with and without stealth headers) was blocked every time by Walmart's PerimeterX bot wall ('Robot or human?' press-and-hold challenge, HTTP 307 redirect to a block page). Tier 2 (local Playwright/Chromium, headless, with navigator.webdriver spoofed and AutomationControlled disabled) hit the identical block. Escalated to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, a real logged-in Chrome session) per the hard-block rule, which rendered pages normally; robots.txt has no Claude/Anthropic-specific disallow (checked first). All discovery and qty were done via rendered PLP/category pages (breadcrumbs + displayed result-count heading), navigated from Walmart's own site search chip modules and category breadcrumbs (Home > Holiday Decor > ... and Seasonal > ... and Party & Occasions > ...), not from raw keyword search alone. Scope kept to Home/Decor-relevant seasonal categories per the task (Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving); Halloween/Easter costume, candy, toy, and generic Party Supplies (paper plates/napkins/banners) categories were excluded as out of scope even where 'Thanksgiving'/'Halloween' named nodes existed for them. QTY finding: Walmart's PLP result-count header is capped at the literal string '1000+' once a category's matched-item count (which includes broad/loose keyword matching, not just true SKU membership) exceeds 1000 - this was confirmed non-exact by spot-checking both large categories (Christmas Trees, Christmas Decor overall) AND deliberately small/niche ones (Christmas Tree Toppers, Halloween Doormats, Christmas Nutcrackers), all of which also returned '1000+' despite obviously small true assortments - consistent with the known 'storefront count APIs are inflated' pattern for other big-box retailers in this project. Per the qty rule (never estimate/infer), every row that hit this cap is recorded qty:null with flag 'MANUAL REVIEW: displayed count capped at literal 1000+, not an exact total; Walmart does not expose a true count on this PLP'. Only exact sub-1000 counts (none qualified among the genuine home-decor categories found; Diwali's plain keyword search showed an exact 708 but was excluded as non-taxonomy, see below) would have been recorded as numbers. HOLIDAYS CHECKED: (1) Christmas - full dedicated taxonomy under Home>Holiday Decor>Christmas Decor with many real /browse/ sub-category pages (breadcrumbs verified); included below, with 'Christmas Tree Decorations' and 'Indoor Christmas Decorations' kept as grouping rows since Ornaments/Tree-Skirts/Tree-Toppers and Tabletop/Stockings/Nutcrackers are their child leaf pages respectively (avoids double count with the group's own capped total). Excluded 'Hallmark Keepsake Ornaments' shelf link (facet_id filtered search, a brand shelf, not a genuine holiday category). (2) Halloween - full dedicated taxonomy under Home>Holiday Decor>Halloween Decor (hub cp/9379334) with real /browse/ sub-pages; included below. Excluded 'My Texas House Halloween Decor' (single-brand shop page) and the two facet-filtered search links (Halloween Kitchen & Dining variants) that were plain search+facet URLs rather than distinct taxonomy nodes - kept the one clean /shop/halloween-kitchen-and-dining page instead. (3) Easter - real dedicated taxonomy found under a separate 'Seasonal' department (breadcrumb Seasonal > Easter > Easter Decorations) with real /browse/seasonal/ sub-pages (Indoor/Outdoor/Wreaths/Gnomes/Lights/Baskets/Eggs/Inflatables); included below as children of the 'Easter Decorations' group. Additional Party & Occasions-scoped Easter links (Hanging Decorations, Banners & Garlands, Tableware, Grass) were left out as out-of-scope party-supply items per task instructions, except none were home-decor-distinct enough to include. (4) Thanksgiving - no dedicated Home>Holiday-Decor hub exists (search chips for 'thanksgiving decor' were AI-generated filter buttons, not real category links, confirmed by inspecting DOM: buttons not links). A genuine breadcrumbed category was found instead under Party & Occasions > Party Supplies > Party Tableware > Centerpieces > Thanksgiving Centerpieces (real /browse/ page) - included as the one home/tabletop-decor-relevant Thanksgiving category; sibling nodes (thanksgiving-party-decorations, -party-tableware, -dessert-treat-decorating, -party-supplies) were checked and confirmed to be Party Supplies-scoped (paper goods/costumes/party favors), so excluded as out of scope. (5) Valentine's Day - checked via site search ('valentines day decor', "valentine's day decorations"); only an AI-generated 'Explore All' curated module (60 items, plain filter buttons with href='#', no /browse/ or /cp/ taxonomy link) was found, no genuine dedicated category page exists - recorded as NO genuine category. (6) New Year - checked via site search ('new year decorations'); same AI-generated filter-button pattern with no genuine /browse/ or /cp/ category link - NO genuine category. (7) Diwali - checked via site search ('diwali decor'); returned an exact 708-item keyword search result but with only generic filter buttons (no /browse/ or /cp/ taxonomy link, confirmed via DOM inspection) - NO genuine dedicated category, so excluded per the 'genuine PLP with own taxonomy URL' rule (a keyword search result page is not itself a category). Checked nav breadcrumbs, the Home>Holiday Decor hub, the separate Seasonal>Easter hub, and Party & Occasions>Thanksgiving hub before concluding absence for Valentine's Day, New Year, and Diwali - no site-owned taxonomy category exists for these on walmart.com's Home/Decor department, only broad keyword search results.
